title_en: Stealing the Bell While Covering One's Ears
page_text_en:
Fan's Residence
Covering One's Ears While Stealing a Bell
summary_zh: 本页展示了故事标题“掩耳盗铃”，背景为范府大门，左侧有一个戴眼罩的小偷靠近大铃铛，右侧有一只兔子，画面呈现故事开端的场景。

title_en: Stealing the Bell While Covering One's Ears
page_text_ocr_zh: 从前，有个盗贼到范氏家中去偷东西。他发现范氏家的门外有一口古钟。
page_text_en: Once upon a time, a thief went to the Fan family's home to steal things. He found an ancient bell outside the Fan family's gate.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了一个戴眼罩的小偷靠近范府门口的古钟，文字说明他前来偷窃并发现了这口钟，故事由此展开。

title_en: Stealing the Bell While Covering One's Ears
page_text_ocr_zh: 盗贼心想它一定很值钱，便想把这座大钟偷走。可是这口钟太大了，又非常重，他根本就背不动。怎么办呢？盗贼急得没有办法，他围着这口大钟转来转去。
page_text_en: The thief thought it must be very valuable, so he wanted to steal this big bell. But the bell was too big and too heavy; he couldn't carry it at all. What should he do? The thief was desperate and had no idea, so he walked around the big bell, going round and round.
summary_zh: 盗贼发现范府门口的大钟很值钱，想偷走却因钟太大太重而无法搬动，急得在钟旁转来转去。

title_en: Stealing the Bell While Covering One's Ears
page_text_ocr_zh: 突然他想到，用大铁锤把钟敲碎，然后再一块一块地偷走不就行了！反正碎铜也能卖不少钱呢！盗贼为自己能想到这个好主意暗暗高兴！
page_text_en: Suddenly he thought, 'Why not use a big iron hammer to smash the bell, and then steal it piece by piece? After all, scrap copper can still sell for quite a bit of money!' The thief secretly rejoiced at his brilliant idea!
summary_zh: 盗贼想到用铁锤砸碎大钟，再分块偷走，为自己想出的办法感到高兴。

title_en: Stealing the Bell While Covering One's Ears
page_text_ocr_zh: 于是他找了一把大锤子，刚试着轻轻一碰大钟，大钟立刻就低沉地响了起来。盗贼吓了一跳，赶紧停了下来，心里砰砰直跳，紧张极了！等到钟声停下来，他想：“只是轻轻一碰就响了，若使劲一砸，那钟声让范家的人听到还得了！这可不行，得想个法子。”
page_text_en: So he found a big hammer, and just as he gently touched the big bell, it immediately rang out with a deep sound. The thief jumped in fright, quickly stopped, his heart pounding, extremely nervous! After the bell sound stopped, he thought: "Just a light touch makes it ring. If I hit it hard, the sound will alert the people of the Fan family! This won't do. I must think of a way."
summary_zh: 盗贼尝试用锤子轻碰大钟，结果钟声响起，他惊慌失措，意识到若用力砸钟会惊动范家，于是决定想办法解决这个问题。

title_en: Stealing the Bell While Covering One's Ears
page_text_ocr_zh: 怎么办呢？盗贼急得不行。贼不走空，总不能白来一趟吧？忽然他灵机一动，想出了一个高明的办法！
page_text_en: What should I do? The thief was in a panic. A thief can't leave empty-handed; he can't come all this way for nothing, right? Suddenly, he had a brilliant idea!
summary_zh: 盗贼因无法搬动大钟而焦急，突然灵机一动，想出了一个自认为高明的办法。

title_en: Stealing the Bell While Covering One's Ears
page_text_ocr_zh: 大钟一响，耳朵就能听见，如果我把耳朵掩上，让它听不见声音不就没事了吗？
page_text_en: When the big bell rings, the ears can hear it. If I cover my ears, won't it be fine if it can't hear the sound?
summary_zh: 盗贼想到用捂住耳朵的方法来避免听到钟声，自以为这样就不会被发现，表现出其自欺欺人的想法。

title_en: Stealing the Bell While Covering One's Ears
page_text_ocr_zh: 于是盗贼就把自己的耳朵掩得严严实实的。
page_text_en: So the thief covered his ears tightly.
summary_zh: 盗贼将耳朵捂得严严实实，试图通过自欺欺人的方式避免听到钟声，以为这样就不会被发现。

title_en: Stealing the Bell While Covering One's Ears
page_text_ocr_zh: 然后用大力气抡起铁锤朝大钟砸去。大锤子刚砸下去顿时发出了巨大的响声，洪亮的钟声在夜空中飘扬！
page_text_en: Then, with great effort, he swung the iron hammer toward the big bell. The moment the hammer struck, a huge sound erupted, and the loud bell toll echoed through the night sky!
summary_zh: 盗贼用铁锤砸向大钟，钟声巨大，响彻夜空。

title_en: Stealing the Bell While Covering One's Ears
page_text_ocr_zh: 范氏家人都被钟声惊醒了。
page_text_en: The Fan family was all awakened by the bell's sound.
summary_zh: 范氏家人都被大钟被砸响的声音惊醒了，故事发展至被发现的结局。

title_en: Stealing the Bell While Covering One's Ears
page_text_ocr_zh: 还没等盗贼把钟敲碎，范氏家的人已经把他团团围住，把他绑得结结实实，狠狠地痛打了一顿！这时，这个盗贼趴在地上，还在愚蠢地说：“我已经把耳朵给掩住了，你们怎么还听见钟声啊？”
page_text_en: Before the thief could even break the bell, the people of the Fan family had already surrounded him, tied him up tightly, and beat him severely! At this moment, the thief lay on the ground, still foolishly saying, "I've already covered my ears—how come you can still hear the bell ringing?"
summary_zh: 盗贼砸钟后被范氏家人发现并围住，遭到痛打，他仍自欺欺人地辩解自己捂住了耳朵，不明白为何别人仍能听见钟声。

title_en: Stealing the Bell While Covering One's Ears
page_text_ocr_zh: 范氏家人刚刚还在为盗贼偷钟生气，听了盗贼的蠢话后，都不禁哈哈大笑起来！
page_text_en: The Fan family had just been angry about the thief stealing the bell, but after hearing the thief's foolish words, they couldn't help but burst out laughing!
summary_zh: 范氏家人在听到盗贼自欺欺人的辩解后，从愤怒转为大笑，故事以幽默的方式收尾。

title_en: Stealing the Bell While Covering One's Ears
page_text_ocr_zh:
思考
这个成语比喻的是自己欺骗自己，明明掩盖不住的事情偏要想办法掩盖，这样反而会闹大笑话的哟。
page_text_en:
Thinking
This idiom metaphorically refers to deceiving oneself; when something is clearly impossible to hide, one still tries to cover it up, which only ends up causing a big laugh.
summary_zh: 本页通过卡通狮子的思考，解释了故事所蕴含的成语寓意：自欺欺人，试图掩盖无法掩盖的事实，最终只会闹出笑话。
